title: Skeleton Rigging Joint Hierarchy Viewer with Particle Effects
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive skeleton rigging joint hierarchy viewer with particle effects. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Dark background (0x0a0a1a) with a perspective camera at position (0, 3, 8) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (0x334466, intensity 0.4) and a directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at (5, 10, 5).
- Render on full-window canvas with antialiasing enabled.
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation.

## Skeleton Hierarchy
- Build a humanoid skeleton using Three.js Bone objects with the following hierarchy:
  - Root (hip) at (0, 1, 0)
    - Spine at relative (0, 0.5, 0)
      - Chest at relative (0, 0.5, 0)
        - Head at relative (0, 0.6, 0)
        - LeftShoulder at relative (-0.4, 0.3, 0)
          - LeftElbow at relative (-0.5, 0, 0)
            - LeftHand at relative (-0.4, 0, 0)
        - RightShoulder at relative (0.4, 0.3, 0)
          - RightElbow at relative (0.5, 0, 0)
            - RightHand at relative (0.4, 0, 0)
    - LeftHip at relative (-0.25, -0.1, 0)
      - LeftKnee at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
        - LeftFoot at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
    - RightHip at relative (0.25, -0.1, 0)
      - RightKnee at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
        - RightFoot at relative (0, -0.6, 0)
- Visualize each joint as a small sphere (radius 0.08, 0x00ffaa emissive material).
- Draw bones as thin cylinders (radius 0.02, 0x44aaff) connecting parent-child joints.
- The skeleton helper lines should also be visible.

## Joint Selection & Highlighting
- Implement raycasting on click to select joints. When a joint sphere is clicked:
  - Highlight it by changing its emissive color to 0xff4444 and scaling it to 1.5x.
  - Highlight all ancestor joints in the chain up to root with emissive 0xffaa00 and scale 1.2x.
  - Highlight all descendant joints with emissive 0x4444ff and scale 1.1x.
  - Previously selected joints revert to default (0x00ffaa, scale 1.0).
- Store the selected joint name in state.

## Particle Effects
- Maintain a particle system with exactly 200 particles using THREE.Points with BufferGeometry.
- Particles are initially dormant (alpha 0, not moving).
- When a joint is selected, spawn particles from that joint's world position:
  - Particles radiate outward in random directions with initial speed between 0.5 and 2.0.
  - Each particle has a lifetime of 2.0 seconds, fading alpha from 1.0 to 0.0.
  - Particle color matches the selected joint highlight color (0xff4444).
  - Track activeParticleCount (particles with lifetime > 0).

## Animation Poses
- Implement 3 preset poses activated by keyboard:
  - Press '1' for T-Pose: all joints at default positions (arms straight out).
  - Press '2' for A-Pose: shoulders rotated down 30 degrees on Z axis.
  - Press '3' for Wave-Pose: right shoulder Z = -45deg, right elbow Z = -90deg, and animate the right hand with a sinusoidal Z rotation (amplitude 20deg, frequency 2Hz).
- Pose transitions should interpolate over 0.5 seconds using lerp/slerp.
- Track currentPose ('t-pose', 'a-pose', 'wave-pose') and poseTransitionProgress (0.0 to 1.0).

## Joint Rotation Gizmo
- When a joint is selected, show a simple rotation gizmo (3 colored torus rings: red=X, green=Y, blue=Z) around the selected joint.
- Press 'X', 'Y', or 'Z' keys to select rotation axis, then use mouse wheel to rotate the selected joint on that axis by 5 degrees per wheel tick.
- Track the cumulative rotation applied to the selected joint per axis in degrees.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left overlay panel (semi-transparent dark background) showing:
  - 'Selected Joint: [name or None]'
  - 'Current Pose: [pose name]'
  - 'Active Particles: [count]'
  - 'Rotation Axis: [X/Y/Z/None]'
  - 'Joint Depth: [depth in hierarchy, root=0]'
- Bottom bar with 3 buttons: 'T-Pose', 'A-Pose', 'Wave Pose' that trigger the same poses as keyboard.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame with:
  - selectedJoint: string|null (name of selected joint)
  - selectedJointDepth: number (depth in hierarchy, root=0, null joint=-1)
  - currentPose: string ('t-pose','a-pose','wave-pose')
  - poseTransitionProgress: number (0.0 to 1.0, 1.0 when complete)
  - activeParticleCount: number (particles currently alive)
  - totalJointCount: number (total bones in skeleton)
  - highlightedAncestorCount: number
  - highlightedDescendantCount: number
  - rotationAxis: string|null ('X','Y','Z' or null)
  - jointRotations: object mapping joint names to {x, y, z} in degrees
  - particleSystemActive: boolean
  - gizmoVisible: boolean
  - frameCount: number (incremented each frame)
  - jointWorldPositions: object mapping joint names to {x, y, z} world coords
  - boneCount: number (number of bone connections drawn)
  - animationPlaying: boolean (true during wave pose hand animation or pose transition)
physics_constraints: Particle velocities must decay naturally over lifetime. Joint hierarchy parent-child relationships must be maintained during rotations (child joints inherit parent transforms). Pose interpolation must use proper quaternion slerp to avoid gimbal lock. Particle count must never exceed 200. All world positions must be NaN-free.
